pages.name: Reti: Lisitsin: 3.Ng5 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had dxe5 (the d3-pawn can only take on e4) and plan 2 recaptured on d3 with ...0-0 notation. Rewritten around dxe4, Bc4 and Ng5 against f7, and ...Bc5/...h6 (a c4-bishop stops short castling).

pages.name: Reti: Lisitsin: 3.Ng5 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 1 claimed fxe3 creates a passed d-pawn; plans used 0-0. Rewritten around Bxe3 or fxe3 and Black's half-open f-file.

pages.name: Zukertort Opening: Dutch Variation
pages.notes: Plans read e6/g6 squares as moves and had a rook lift Rf6-h6 with no rook able to reach f6. Rewritten around the three Dutch set-ups and the Lisitsin Gambit.

pages.name: Zukertort Opening: Slav Invitation
pages.notes: Plan 4 read d4 as Black's move; American spelling. Rewritten around Slav/Réti transpositions and ...Bf5/...Bg4 before ...e6.

pages.name: Zukertort Opening: Vos Gambit
pages.notes: Overview and plans missed that after 3.dxe5 dxe5 4.Qxd8+ Kxd8 5.Nxe5 White wins the e5-pawn; plan used Kxd8 without its line. Rewritten around the gambit's real point.

pages.name: Zukertort Opening: Wade Defense
pages.notes: Plan read h3 and Bxf3 as Black's moves. Rewritten around the real pin (e2 has moved), 3.h3 Bxf3 4.Qxf3 and White's bishop pair.

pages.name: King's Indian Attack
pages.notes: Plans used e4-e5 as a route, 0-0, and vague long-diagonal play. Rewritten around the KIA plan; reviewer rejection (...Bf5/...Bg4 after ...e6 is blocked) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans used f2-f4-f5 as a route and ...d5 to neutralise a g2-bishop not yet there. Rewritten.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans used f2-f4-f5 as a route and vague long-diagonal play; American spelling. Rewritten with ...b6/...Bb7 and Nh4/f4.

pages.name: Reti: KIA
pages.notes: Plans used e4-e5 as a route and had the f3-knight going to e1 then g2, where the bishop stands. Rewritten.
